import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, KFold
import os

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features
target_cols = ["formation_energy_ev_natom", "bandgap_energy_ev"]
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["id"] + target_cols]

X = train[feature_cols].copy()
y_formation = train["formation_energy_ev_natom"].copy()
y_bandgap = train["bandgap_energy_ev"].copy()

# Handle categorical features (spacegroup)
cat_features = ["spacegroup"] if "spacegroup" in X.columns else []

# Train/validation split (80/20) - hold-out set for validation metric
X_train, X_val, y_formation_train, y_formation_val, y_bandgap_train, y_bandgap_val = (
    train_test_split(X, y_formation, y_bandgap, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
)

# K-fold cross-validation for training more robust models
n_splits = 5
kf = KFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# Train models with K-fold CV
model_formation = CatBoostRegressor(
    iterations=150,
    depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    cat_features=cat_features,
    verbose=False,
    random_seed=42,
)
model_bandgap = CatBoostRegressor(
    iterations=150,
    depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    cat_features=cat_features,
    verbose=False,
    random_seed=42,
)

# Train on full training data (not including hold-out validation set)
model_formation.fit(X_train, y_formation_train)
model_bandgap.fit(X_train, y_bandgap_train)

# Predict on validation set (hold-out)
y_formation_pred = model_formation.predict(X_val)
y_bandgap_pred = model_bandgap.predict(X_val)


# Calculate RMSLE for each target
def rmsle(y_true, y_pred):
    return np.sqrt(np.mean((np.log(y_true + 1) - np.log(y_pred + 1)) ** 2))


rmsle_formation = rmsle(y_formation_val, y_formation_pred)
rmsle_bandgap = rmsle(y_bandgap_val, y_bandgap_pred)
mean_rmsle = (rmsle_formation + rmsle_bandgap) / 2

print(f"Formation Energy RMSLE: {rmsle_formation:.6f}")
print(f"Bandgap Energy RMSLE: {rmsle_bandgap:.6f}")
print(f"Mean Column-wise RMSLE: {mean_rmsle:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
X_test = test[feature_cols].copy()
test_formation_pred = model_formation.predict(X_test)
test_bandgap_pred = model_bandgap.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test["id"],
        "formation_energy_ev_natom": test_formation_pred,
        "bandgap_energy_ev": test_bandgap_pred,
    }
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
